N8N Chat UI

Maker

📌

Hey Product Hunt 👋 Ross (@ross\_jenkins) & Dani (@dani\_martin1), the owners of N8N Chat UI.  
  
The problem  
n8n is brilliant for building AI agents, but its built-in chat widget is basic. Making it look like your brand means digging into HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and your webhook URL sits in the page source for anyone to find.  
  
What we built  
A visual builder that turns any n8n workflow into a polished, on-brand chat widget. Customize it with a live preview, copy one snippet, and it's on your site. No code.  
Try the builder yourself, no signup needed: n8nchatui.com  
  
Key features

 Popup or in-page widgets, fully themed: colors, fonts, avatars, welcome messages, custom CSS [...] From the dashboard you can change:

 Colours: header, background, your messages, bot messages, the input box and the send button, each set separately.
 Shape and size: width, height, corner rounding on the window, messages, input and buttons, plus font size.
 Branding: your own title, avatars for the bot and the user, a welcome message and starter prompts. You can also remove our footer.
 Layout: a pop-up chat bubble (choose its icon and position, and add an optional tooltip) or a full-page chat window that sits inside your page.

If you need more than that, custom CSS gives you full control, for example to use your brand font.

You can watch the changes in a live preview as you go, so it's quick to get right.
